messages:
maria_sales: Hi team — onboarding for MerchantCo POC is stuck. They can’t get API keys bound to the Dedicated pool after the IdP provisioning. Started today during the setup window.
eli_eng: What precisely fails? Is it key creation or the SAML/SCIM user import?
sam_se: Customer reports that service account users show up but group membership isn’t applied, so routing policy to dedicated GPUs never kicks in.
kevin_it: Okta shows SCIM provisioning success on our side (200) but the Redwood side returns 403 when trying to assign the dedicated_scope role.
okta-bot: Provisioning event: user_create user=mc_jdoe status=200 timestamp=2026-04-06T14:02:19Z
eli_eng: Can you paste the SCIM response body and the failing 403 logs? Need to see the role claim mapping.
adrian_cs: Pasting redacted SCIM snippet from customer (they removed PII):
```
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "jdoe@merchant.co",
  "name": {"givenName": "John","familyName": "Doe"},
  "groups": ["data-team"]
}
```
eli_eng: That payload looks fine. On our side the attach-to-dedicated API requires a `roles` attribute with exact match: `redwood:dedicated:pool-<pool-id>`. If SCIM side isn’t including a role mapping, assignment will fail.
maria_sales: MerchantCo claims they followed the OOTB Okta assignment guide though. Could this be an attribute mapping mismatch?
kevin_it: Their SAML assertion also lacks the `eduPersonPrincipalName` we ask for sometimes; but we can map `userName`. However group-to-role mapping is controlled by SCIM extension in their Okta app — looks like we didn’t receive `roles`.
sam_se: Quick workaround: I can generate a Hosted API key scoped to the dedicated pool and give them temporary access while we fix SCIM mapping. Would that work for a 24–48h POC window?
adrian_cs: Customer prefers not to use Hosted keys for Dedicated traffic — needs isolation. But they’ll accept a temporary scoped API key if auditing is enabled.
eli_eng: I can add an acceptance to allow manual assignment via the admin API: `POST /v1/admin/users/:id/assign-role {"role":"redwood:dedicated:pool-abc123"}`. Need devops approval to run this on MerchantCo org.
maria_sales: Please run it after I get signed approval from procurement. Meanwhile, can we get a reproducible failure log for the 403?
eli_eng: Sent request to eng-infra to pull logs — ticket INFRA-4921. @kevin_it can you attach Okta mapping screenshot to that ticket?
kevin_it: Done. Attached Okta Attribute Mappings and SCIM token header screenshot.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: admin-api v2.3.1 -> staging (triggered by @eli_eng)
eli_eng: If the mapping truly never sends roles, short-term fix is to have us accept `groups` from SCIM and translate to roles server-side. Need product sign-off for that change (small policy tweak).
adrian_cs: Customer raised security questionnaire item about requiring signed SCIM payloads and role audit trails. We should confirm we can surface audit logs.
sam_se: We have audit logs for admin assignments; I can enable extended retention for this org for the POC.
maria_sales: OK — plan: 1) I’ll get signed approval for manual assignment; 2) Eli/Infra will pull the 403 trace and try manual assign; 3) Engineering will draft a short-term mapping fallback (groups->roles) if needed; 4) CS enable audit retention. Target to finish by EOD tomorrow.
kevin_it: Sounds good. ETA from infra on logs?
eli_eng: INFRA said 3 hours. Will update thread.
maria_sales: Thanks all — I’ll update MerchantCo and ask them to confirm once they see Dedicated pool traffic. :thumbsup:
